sql: SELECT 'raw_events' AS t, (SELECT min(received_at) FROM wapi_webhook_raw_events)::date AS desde, (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_webhook_raw_events WHERE received_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS n7d UNION ALL SELECT 'trace_logs', (SELECT min(created_at) FROM message_trace_logs)::date, (SELECT count(*) FROM message_trace_logs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days') UNION ALL SELECT 'notifications', (SELECT min(created_at) FROM notifications)::date, (SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days') UNION ALL SELECT 'lead_history', (SELECT min(created_at) FROM lead_history)::date, (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_history WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days') UNION ALL SELECT 'wapi_messages', (SELECT min(created_at) FROM wapi_messages)::date, (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_messages WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days') UNION ALL SELECT 'lead_score_snapshots', (SELECT min(created_at) FROM lead_score_snapshots)::date, (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_score_snapshots WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days') UNION ALL SELECT 'lead_reactivation_history', (SELECT min(created_at) FROM lead_reactivation_history)::date, (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_reactivation_history WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days') UNION ALL SELECT 'db_total_' || pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database())), NULL, NULL
